title: Copper.Mesa.S01E02.2026.1080p.WEB-DL.H264-TESTGRP
description: Six articles of 768,000 bytes with a recovery set over them, the third of which states an =ypart range moved down by half an article, over the part before it. Every decoder writes the body where its header says, so the file is wrong where it lands; the recovery set covers it, and the file must come out byte-equal.
